description: This file implements a database driver class for Netezza within the ADODB database abstraction library. It extends a PostgreSQL driver class, providing specific SQL statements, methods for retrieving metadata (columns), and configurations tailored for Netezza.

classes.name: ADODB_netezza
classes.description: This class provides a driver implementation for the Netezza database, including metadata retrieval, configuration, and specific SQL syntax tailored for Netezza.

methods.name: ADODB_netezza
methods.description: Constructor for the Netezza driver class.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table, adjusted for Netezza's system tables and data types.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_netezza
classes.description: An extension of the PostgreSQL record set class, customized for handling Netezza query results, with specific fetch modes and initialization logic.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_netezza
methods.description: Constructor for the Netezza-specific record set, setting fetch modes based on parameters.

methods.name: _initrs
methods.description: Initializes the record set, specifically handling the number of rows and fields, disabling blob handling.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches column metadata for a given table, processing data types and lengths specific to Netezza.
